correctness.rationale: For any convex polygon N>=4, conditioning on a fixed noncrossing set S factors the uniform triangulation law into independent uniformly triangulated polygonal cells. Two admissible diagonals in different cells are independent; if they cross in the same cell the joint inclusion probability is zero and covariance strictly negative; if noncrossing in the same cell, count three subpolygons with positive triangle numbers a,b,c and obtain covariance C_a*C_c*(C_b*C_(a+b+c)-C_(a+b)*C_(b+c))/C_(a+b+c)^2. The exact ratios C_(j+1)/C_j=4-6/(j+2), strictly increasing, establish the strict sign for all a,c>=1. By successive compatible conditioning, for any compatible A,B one gets W(A union B)W(A intersection B)>=W(A)W(B), equality exactly when no cell after A intersection B gets diagonals from both set differences. For nonempty A,B, positive covariance of inclusion events follows even when one set contains the other because P(E_(A intersection B))<1. Independently checked 588 Catalan strict inequalities; the analytic proof covers all polygon sizes. This does not assert FKG for crossing or general increasing events.

originality.rationale: Catalan counting, dissection factorization and log-convexity are classical. Eppstein–Frishberg 2023 full PDF exploits products of Catalan subproblems for flip-walk mixing; Black et al 2023 treat pairs of disjoint triangulations. The inspected pertinent results do not state the all-partial-triangulation conditional covariance sign law, compatible-family log-supermodularity with sharp cell-level equality, or strictly positive unconditional association for any two nonempty compatible sets. General FKG on all diagonal coordinates is false because crossing pairs are negatively correlated. This is best-of-knowledge originality, with potential unindexed correlation inequalities/associahedron-face results a real priority risk.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the exact positive, zero, and negative dependence regime for any two diagonal indicators after arbitrary compatible conditioning, and gives an all-orders positive-association inequality with an exact independence/equality criterion. These are natural probability questions for the uniform random Catalan triangulation and for conditioning sampling algorithms. Though derived from classical log-convexity, its fully quantified signed-dependence classification is more than a renamed elementary count.
